name: Fext
languages: the languages spoken by its patron

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The fext's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: hex

3/day each: counterspell, fear, gaseous form

1/day each: hold monster, true seeing

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The fext has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The fext's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Patron Blessing
traits.text: A fext is infused with a portion of their patron's power. They have an Armor Class equal to 10 + their Charisma modifier + their Dexterity modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fext makes two melee or ranged attacks.

actions.name: Eldritch Blade
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Fury
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60/200 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) force damage.
